gaps.wanted: What the SYNC OUT and IN BNC jacks carry (a 1PPS, a 10 MHz reference, a ReadyLinks stacking clock) and at what impedance. The datasheet names them "(2) BNC sync ports" in its panel figure and nowhere else; the catalogue API and the product page are silent.
What the front USB-C port is for (console, storage, power); the datasheet's panel figure does not call it out and no other held text names it.
What SYS, PWR, ALM and SYNC and the port lamps show in each colour. No held document has an LED table; the colours drawn are the GLB's and the render's.
Orderable part numbers for the 12-port BNC line card and the slot blank, and whether a card is sold on its own. The datasheets, catalogue API and product pages name only whole switches.
Which side wall takes air in and which exhausts; the fans sit behind both walls and no held document says.

a `power-draw-max-w` on each module this chassis accepts, from the vendor's own per-card table - Cisco publishes one per ambient, most vendors publish none, and until they land a module total is a floor

bottom-layout.note: drawing - sixteen screw heads (about 5.5 across; common/screw-head@1 is 3.6) found as bright discs in an orthographic render of the GLB underside at 6 px/mm. Axis convention: y = 0 is the REAR as on the top view, and x is mirrored because the face is seen from below (x = 0 is the chassis's right side as seen from the front).

chassis.note: drawing - the GLB body is 440.0 wide between the side walls (GL24X-1U-003B, x -220 to 220), 45.0 tall (bottom plate at y 0.5, top plate's top at 45.5) and 300.1 deep from the front panel face (z 160.35) to the rear panel face (z -139.75). The datasheet reads "12'(L) x 19'(W) x 1.75'(H) (305mm x 228.6mm x 44.45mm)": 19 in is the rack face with the ears (the GLB ears, PRODUCT_1304, make it 482.6), 12 in is 305 against 300.1 and 1.75 in is 1RU against 45.0. The deltas are per-axis (42.6, 4.9, -0.55) and not a scale factor, so they are ears and rounding, and the CAD body is modelled. The sheet's 228.6 mm is 9 in, a slip for the 19 in it prints beside it. Ears are not drawn.

cooling.note: drawing - ten 40 x 20 mm fans (40X20_1), five behind each side-wall grille, so the air moves side to side. Which side takes air in is stated nowhere held.

front-layout.note: drawing - every position is measured off the GLB in face coordinates (x from the left side wall, y down from the top plate). The fixed left panel (GL24X-1U-005B) runs x 0 to 132.4; the two line-card plates (GL24X-1U-NEWBNC and GL24X-DANGPAN) x 132.70 to 414.20 at y 2.35 to 21.90 and 23.05 to 42.60, flush with the panel at z 160.35, with a 1.15 rail of chassis metal between them; the right panel (GL24X-1U-007B) x 414.5 to 440. Openings were found as depth-map regions behind the panel plane at 8 px/mm: GE2/GE1 12.75 x 10.88 at (107.88, 8.00) and 12.62 x 10.75 at (107.88, 24.38), in a shell whose visible face runs y 7.32 to 35.6 (the GLB box reaches 38.65 with the light pipes below); SFP+2/SFP+1 14.1 x 10.9 centred (96.06, 15.69) and 14.25 x 10.75 centred (96.0, 29.5) in a 14.9 x 25.0 cage; console 12.25 x 11.0 in a 15.9 x 13.4 housing centred (42.86, 28.5); USB-C 8.25 x 2.75 centred (57.25, 33.62); reset hole 3.38 across at (67.19, 31.06). Lamp lenses 3.0 across: status at x 30.6, y 17.4 / 22.5 / 27.6 / 32.7; the two SFP light pipes 1.5 x 1.35 at (91.35, 22.6) and (100.65, 22.6). The sync jacks' collars (SYNC_1) are 9.30 across, centred at (79.60, 12.33) and (79.60, 28.33), their fronts 11.9 in front of the panel.

lifecycle.note: the catalogue API lists the GL-12xB-240D as a current product (created 2026-04-09) and the datasheet is dated 2026-07-27; no end-of-life notice was found on the vendor's site.

line-cards.note: datasheet - the panel figure labels the two openings "(2) Line card slots", and the PoE row reads "Ports 11 and 12 of each line card are PoE++ ports", so the twelve BNC jacks are a card in a slot and not part of the chassis. The GLB agrees: the card (GL24XB_ASM, a 269.5 x 170.8 board behind its faceplate) and the blank (GL24X-DANGPAN) are their own assemblies, each held by a captive thumbscrew at each end. The GL-12xB ships the card in the upper slot and the blank in the lower (datasheet photograph, product render and GLB all agree); the GL-24xB datasheet lists 24 ports on the same chassis, which is the second card.

poe-polarity.note: datasheet, and probably copied - the PoE row of this BNC model's sheet reads "(F center pole: DC-, F shield: DC+)", the wording of the F-type GL-12xC sheet. On a BNC jack it can only mean the centre contact is DC- and the shell DC+; recorded as printed rather than corrected, since the polarity is a fact about the port and nothing held states it in BNC terms.

port-leds.note: drawing - status lamps are 3.0 mm lenses in the GLB (LED_4_1), drawn with common/led-dot@1 (2.0), the library's round lamp and the one the GL-8xEP uses; the diameter delta is recorded here. The SFP light pipes are triangles in the render, the left pointing down and the right up, so the left serves SFP+1 below and the right SFP+2 above; drawn with common/led-arrow-sm@1, down and up. The GbE lamps are the corner lamps of common/rj45-ganged-eth@1, which is where the GLB puts them (in the shell corners on each jack's keyway side).

power.note: datasheet - "Maxpower consumption 80W (Excluding PoE output)" is power-self-max-w; "Total available PoE 240W (Using dual power) 90W (Using single power)" is the PoE budget; "Power supply AC/DC, internal, (2) 300W"; "Power input 100-240V AC, 50/60 Hz 48-56VDC". The sheet gives no figure for the box at full PoE load, so power-max-w is not stated; the two figures are not added together here. The two supplies are inside (the GLB has two RPS-300 boards behind the inlets) and are not field-replaceable, so they are not bays.

rear-layout.note: drawing - measured off the GLB rear (x from the left as seen from behind). Two C14 inlets on screw flanges (POWER_1, 50.0 x 22.5, screws 40 apart), the keyed shroud centred at (34.92, 29.47) and (404.45, 30.17); a 21 x 15 rocker switch above each (KAIGUAN_1) at (23.9, 2.4) and (394.7, 1.8); two six-pole headers (6P_FANFENGHUANG) at x 182.1 and 225.5, y 26.8 to 35.4, with latch posts to 24.3; a 3.4 mm hole at (360.0, 32.5). The datasheet photograph names them "Primary power" (left), "Secondary power" (right) and "DC power stacking ports", and shows what the GLB omits: ON and OFF either side of each switch, -48V and -48VRTN under each header, an earth mark at about x 349.7 and a hex nut on a stud in the hole, read at about 3.0 px/mm. The cord-retention bails over each inlet (SUS-DIANXIANKOU) are cable management and are not drawn.

serial-label.note: photo-measured - a white QR and serial sticker on the right panel, 19.7 x 19.8 at (415.6, 12.6), read off the product render at 3.616 px/mm (the GLB's right panel is untextured). Drawn as a plain label plate with placeholder blocks where the code and the serial string are; neither is transcribed.

side-layout.note: drawing - each side wall carries five round fan grilles, 40 holes about 3.9 across in a 32.8 circle centred 22.3 down, with the fans' screws at two opposite corners, 16 mm from the centre each way. Centres on the RIGHT view (x = 0 at the front) 53.75, 102.73, 152.73, 213.73, 259.73; on the LEFT view (x = 0 at the rear) 40.25, 86.25, 147.25, 197.25, 246.23, which is the right side mirrored (depth - x) to 0.1 mm. The holes are drawn with the library's `holes` pattern at a 5.2 pitch clipped to the circle, which gives the density and extent but not the rings of the real grille.

silkscreen.note: drawing - the GLB carries the panel legends as flat meshes on the plate, so their positions are measured off a 12 px/mm render: SYS/PWR/ALM/SYNC left-aligned at x 18.0, each baseline 1.1 below its lamp's centre, cap height 2.8; CONSOLE and USB on baseline 41.0; SYNC with its two bracket arms (verticals at x 66.0, arms to 71.25 at y 12.1 and 28.2); OUT on 5.0 and IN on 37.9; SFP+2 on 6.9 and SFP+1 on 39.8; GE2 on 5.0 and GE1 on 39.8. Six of these sit off their part's centre and L61 says so, and the offsets are the CAD's, not slips: CONSOLE 1.66 left of the console jack, USB 1.35 right of the USB-C, SFP+2 and SFP+1 0.78 left of the cage, GE2 and GE1 1.02 left of the RJ45 openings (each word is centred on its own print block, which is not the connector's centre on this panel); they stay where the GLB and the product render put them. The ReadyLinks wordmark is not a mesh (it is a texture); it is placed from the product render at 3.616 px/mm (x 14.4 to 48.7, baseline about 9.7, cap height about 4.5) and drawn as plain text, not in the vendor's bold face. The wireless-arc mark above it is not drawn (no vendor logos); the logo-zone region reserves it.

sources.note: vendor GLB 3D model (gl-12xb.glb from the product page's model viewer - a KeyShot CAD export, 812 nodes, 2.19 million triangles, Draco-compressed, per-part meshes at millimetre scale), read two ways: part boxes with spec/tools/intake/glb_parts.py, and orthographic z-buffered renders of each face at 4 to 20 px/mm; the vendor datasheet (ReadyLinks-GL-12xB-240D-Datasheet.pdf, three pages, whose page 3 panel figure is a 1600 px photograph of the front and rear with callouts and a three-quarter view); the vendor product render (gl-12xb/front.png, 1920 x 1079, the same GLB with its textures); and the vendor catalogue API entry. The GLB is the position source for every feature; the datasheet names them; the render and photograph confirm colour and printing.

stack-orientation.note: drawing - the GLB shows the upper RJ45 (GE2) keyway up and the lower (GE1) keyway down, so GE2 turns 180; the SFP+ pair follows the library's belly-to-belly rule (upper at 0, lower at 180), which the GLB's single stacked cage with its lamp band between the two openings matches. The console jack's latch slot is at the bottom.

sync-jacks.note: drawing - the datasheet's panel figure calls out "(2) BNC sync ports", and the faceplate prints OUT over the upper and IN under the lower, joined by a SYNC bracket. They are placed as common/bnc-jack@1, the library's BNC bezel. The GLB draws them as one simplified block with plain barrels, no bayonet lugs, and each collar 0.5 mm off the centre of the wider barrel behind it; the collar is what a plug mates, so the collar centres are used. Which signal they carry, at what level and impedance, no held document says (gap sync-signal).

top-layout.note: drawing - the lid (GL24X-1U-001B) is one flat 427.5 x 293.8 sheet between the tops of the side walls, from 6.2 to 433.8 across and 6.25 to 299.95 from the rear (y = 0 is the REAR, the library's top-view convention); no opening, label or fastener shows on it in an orthographic render of the GLB from above. No held photograph shows the top of this model: the datasheet's three-quarter view is of a twisted-pair sibling (two RJ45 cards, G1 to G12 each), and its lid is plain as well.
